title: chrysanthemum salicifolium
intro: Chrysanthemum salicifolium, commonly known as Willowleaf Chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing fever, relieving headaches and rheumatism, and protecting against cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum salicifolium include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
